# Synevra UltraLift (synevraultraliftserum.onrender.com)

> synevraultraliftserum.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about Synevra UltraLift, a peptide serum and capsule skincare kit. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Serum: advanced peptide serum in a pump bottle; named ingredients dipeptide complex (SYN-AKE), sodium hyaluronate, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), tocopheryl acetate (vitamin E), glycerin, plus biotin; no amounts given; seller says use morning or evening
- Capsule: VitaLock Complex (biotin, niacinamide, zinc and unnamed botanical extracts per the seller), 60 capsules in the photos, a dietary supplement
- The seller does not say what a "bottle" includes; the 3 and 6 bottle photos show serums with a VitaLock bottle and two bonus ebooks
- Packs: 1 bottle $69 plus shipping, 3 bottles $59 each (free US shipping, two ebooks), 6 bottles $49 each (free US shipping, two ebooks); listed as 30, 90 and 180 days
- 60-day money-back guarantee; shipping 5 to 7 business days in the US and Canada by FedEx or UPS (seller's statement)
- Not a treatment for wrinkles or any skin condition; patch test first; biotin can interfere with some blood tests
